title: cluster
description: A proposed relationship between candidates. Similarity is a hypothesis, never a merge decision.

shared_symbols.description: Symbols present in this member AND at least one other member.

overlap_rationale.description: Why these are believed related. Names alone are not rationale.

confidence_basis.description: 'name-only' must never be treated as mergeable.

recommendation.description: Default is 'candidate' or 'needs-verification'. The pipeline never emits 'merge now'.
